_meta.scope: Applications tab: Type G checks on shipped deployment_sites (Army Janus records); Type S new segment entry (data-center PPA); Type E regions checked, none written.
absences: Eielson (Oklo NOITA, deployment_sites eielson-pilot): a June 2026 Eielson newsletter says the Air Force now estimates completion in 2030, but the eielson.af.mil PDF returned HTTP 403 and the 2030 date appears only in a search summary. No check written.

Penn State FRONTIER (psu-frontier and penn-state-evinci) and NASA/DOE lunar (nasa-doe-fsp-lunar): searched for 2026 status; found no 2026 change and no primary page to confirm one. No check written. The lunar record says 'DOE-NASA agreement'; the NASA/DOE sources name a memorandum of understanding (ANS, 2026-01-14). Not fetched from the primary release.
Last Energy London Gateway (segments last-energy-london-gateway): searched for 2026 updates; none found beyond the 2025 MOU. No check written.

Janus power figures: janus-bragg shows 100 kWe-1 MWe per unit, but the Army/AP article fetched describes 'Nuclear microreactors can produce 1-20 megawatts of thermal energy' as a class description. Not reconciled; no power check written.
Hospitals: one search; the only hospital item was a 2022 cogeneration plant, not a microreactor deal. No application written.
Disaster recovery and emergency power: one search; results were proposed bills (not enacted) and an Air Force base FAQ. No signed 2026 agreement found. No application written.

Chemical process heat: Tata/BWXT (Wyoming, 2024) is already shipped. Ciech/Synthos (Poland) letter of intent of 2021 was terminated in October 2023 and replaced by an OSGE BWRX-300 study agreement with no power figure stated for the Ciech deal. L&H Industrial/BWXT joint development agreement (about April 2024) has no deal-specific MWe. Neither has a load or price, so neither was written.

Valar Atomics 30 MW Utah data-center plan: already on the News tab (valar-nvidia-datacenter-2026-06-22), so not added as an application. One source reports the Ward250 output at about 100 kW in June 2026, which conflicts with the 30 MW plan.
Faroe Islands (new Type E region candidate): no 2025 household tariff or system load in MW found. The 2023-24 SEV tariff changes are older than the 2025 price standard. Not written.

Equinix/Oklo deal (applications entry): dcd (datacenterdynamics.com) returned HTTP 403, so the single fetched source is WNN (2024-04-09). Pre-payment amount and binding status are not confirmed from a fetched page.

checks.evidence: The Army and DIU announced on 2026-08-26 that they awarded up to $2.2 billion for vendors to construct, own and operate microreactors on military bases under Janus. Antares Nuclear, Inc. was paired with Fort Bragg. AP wording: 'has awarded'; the Reuters copy on AJOT (2026-08-28) says 'it is awarding'. Neither article gives the contract value for Fort Bragg.

applications.name: Equinix and Oklo letter of intent (right of first refusal on Oklo powerhouses)
applications.timeline: letter of intent reported 2024-04-09; right of first refusal for up to 36 months; 20-year PPA terms if signed
applications.what_it_says: Equinix got a right of first refusal for 100-500 MWe of output from certain Oklo powerhouses, for up to 36 months, to supply its US data centres over a 20-year period. World Nuclear News reports that Oklo 'has also recently signed a letter of intent to provide up to 500 MWe of power to Equinix.' The article gives no price.
applications.microreactor_read: The 100-500 MWe range implies a fleet of units, far beyond one 1-20 MW block. It is a letter of intent with a right of first refusal, with no price and no order, so it is an option rather than a purchase.

sources.label: World Nuclear News — US companies sign up with Oklo for microreactor power (2024-04-09)
sources.quote: Equinix would have a right of first refusal for 100-500 MWe of output from certain powerhouses for up to 36 months.
